operation.summary: The audio of a sound (up to 10 s, from just before it started), when the owner lets sounds send audio (kept in memory 10 minutes unless you chose longer with POST /v1/captures/storage; also GET /v1/captures/{id})
operation.returns: heard_at, duration_seconds, format (wav), sample_rate_hz, size_bytes, data_base64 (or raw=1 bytes)
